entries.title: A card you swipe on iPhone no longer shows a line across its top
entries.body: On iOS 27, swiping a card sideways drew a lighter strip along the card's top, ending in a thin bright line, while the card leaned. The card now stays plain as it leans.
entries.noPicture: The fix removes a strip that showed only mid-swipe; a still of the swiped card without it shows an ordinary card.
